baseline: Frozen V5 target and BCE remain unchanged. V6 is a separate dataset and learning view.

query.geometry: Exact existing quote-native Bollinger, scales 1/3/6, lower/middle/upper
query.selection: First strict crossing of each line after aligned entry ordinal
query.entry: Frozen V5 first supported quote strictly after decision + 100ms, timeout 2s
query.normalizer_R: Frozen decision-time R_event; future realized volatility is forbidden

equity.reference: Pre-entry capital, fee reserved once. Entry equity is already negative.
equity.units: Price units per unit exposure, not dollars per GC futures contract
equity.execution_limit: Hypothetical immediate BBO liquidation at crossing. No exit latency, market impact, queue fills, stops or portfolio constraints simulated by V6. The path continues after risk breach for factual description.

outputs.hit: Per line: 1 if observed by H, 0 if fully followed through H without hit, -1 if unavailable. Not a profitability label.
outputs.conditional_profile: Only for observed hits: net/R, elapsed/60, MAE/R, MFE/R, max drawdown/R, positive/negative equity areas, underwater fraction, first positive/risk times, variation and efficiency
outputs.integrals: Exact right-continuous, piecewise-constant publication values on [entry,cross). Positive and negative areas are nonnegative price*seconds. Divide by R*60 for area_RT, or R*elapsed for mean exposure. They are not realized cash.
outputs.max_drawdown: Peak-to-trough drawdown with initial peak at pre-entry zero; includes entry spread and fee
outputs.risk: First equity <= -R; strict pre-crossing risk flag excludes the crossing publication and includes earlier same-timestamp ordinals
outputs.shape: 17 event-relative right-continuous samples; sample 0 is entry ordinal and 16 crossing ordinal. Signed orthonormal Haar details of samples 1..16. Not physical frequency and not causal input.
outputs.quarter_velocity: Change in equity over each future interval quarter divided by its physical duration. This excludes the initial cost jump, so net is always retained separately.
outputs.average_velocity: Net/R divided by elapsed/60, undefined at zero time. Diagnostic only, excluded from learning_view due to near-zero duration instability.
outputs.geometry: Both strict-anchor dp/dline and full entry-to-cross price/band displacement; moving-line crossing is not evidence of price profit
outputs.sequence: Stable physical event IDs; ordinal packet rank and time since previous packet per origin. Simultaneous line crossings share a packet. Same timestamp does not merge different quote ordinals.

masks.hit_known: Ready geometry, aligned entry, finite positive causal R, and either hit observed or support extends strictly past H
masks.profile_known: Observed first-line hit within H. Negative results are valid targets.
masks.shape_known: profile_known and elapsed > 0; zero-time Haar masked
masks.censoring: Eligible incomplete follow-up is censored, never a no-hit class or zero return. Non-ready geometry is separate.
masks.availability: Observed profiles become labels at cross_ns/cross_ordinal; complete no-hit at deadline; unknown availability is 0. Same-nanosecond ordering must use stored ordinals.

learning.event: 9 separate marginal hit probabilities; BCE is an admissible baseline. No 9-way mutually exclusive softmax.
learning.profile: Conditional factual regression; both directions retained with costs. Never reward merely predicting positive values.
learning.mask_application: Replace invalid targets with a finite placeholder BEFORE arithmetic; use explicit masks in loss and valid-count denominators. Raw artifacts retain NaN for unobserved outcomes.
learning.reference_gradient_figure: At fixed p=0.5 for BCE, and prediction=0/delta=1 for Huber. These are analytical unweighted per-cell gradients, not fitted model gradients or approved loss weights.
learning.next_experiment: Compare minimal net/time/MAE heads with addition of mean negative exposure; then signed shape heads. TRAIN-only scaling, frozen chronological blocks, crossing-ID grouped diagnostics, and actual execution replay. Quantile or robust regression candidates need separate validation.
learning.not_claimed: Learnability, superior calibrated prediction, improved economic performance, or independent holdout novelty. Existing V5 dates were already explored.

causal_clock.representation: sin and cos of UTC clock phase; available_ns equals decision time
causal_clock.limits: UTC daily clock is not London session phase across DST. Future crossing duration is never cyclical. No clock feature has been fitted in this study.
